01 / PROJECT NOTES

ROBOTICS & CONTROL

Traction-aware warehouse rover

How does a loaded autonomous rover track a route when contact with the floor changes?

The problem

Wheel motion and body motion can diverge under limited friction. A controller must track its route while handling payload changes, delayed sensors and noisy estimates.

The implementation

  • A differential-drive plant with independent wheel/body velocity, motor current and friction-limited contact.
  • Linear PI/LQR and nonlinear tracking, compared with traction supervision enabled and disabled.
  • A 540-run matrix spanning controller variants, friction, payload, route and noise seed.
  • ROS 2 integration, sensor estimation, and a custom Pico carrier-board design.

What the evidence means

This is a virtual engineering project. Simulation results and circuit/design checks can be inspected; the assembled board and physical robot have not been validated.

Explore control labRead source code
02 / PROJECT NOTES

REMOTE SENSING & DEEP LEARNING

Satellite tile segmentation

Turn high-resolution aerial imagery into a pixel-wise semantic map without treating the whole image as one model input.

The problem

6000 × 6000 imagery is too large for a straightforward single-pass training pipeline. Patch processing must preserve context and support reconstruction of the full-resolution result.

The implementation

  • Patch extraction and augmentation through a TensorFlow data pipeline.
  • A residual U-Net with multirate dilated convolutions in the bottleneck.
  • Jaccard and focal-loss functions, learning-rate exploration and a one-cycle training policy.
  • Rotation/flip test-time augmentation and scatter-based reconstruction for six semantic classes.

Explore the evidence

The repository includes training notebooks, per-class validation metrics and tile predictions. Results belong to the recorded dataset and experiment setup.

Explore repositoryTraining notebooks
03 / PROJECT NOTES

REPRESENTATION LEARNING & IMAGE QC

VQ-VAE pathology triage

Screen image patches before sending every tile of a gigapixel slide through a heavy segmentation model.

The problem

Large whole-slide images contain background, blur and artifacts as well as useful tissue. Efficient loading and patch screening can help organize downstream computation.

The implementation

  • Memory-mapped image loading with overlapping patch extraction.
  • A PyTorch VQ-VAE with encoder, learned codebook quantizer and decoder.
  • Reconstruction-error thresholds for patch triage.
  • A training loop with automatic mixed precision and an ONNX export path.

Project scope

This is a research and preprocessing prototype. Reconstruction error is a quality signal to inspect, not a clinical diagnosis or a demonstrated diagnostic outcome.

04 / PROJECT NOTES

DECISION SYSTEMS & SUPPLY CHAIN

SupplyShield

When a supplier is unavailable, which alternative purchases can protect priority orders within the remaining constraints?

The implementation

  • A supplier/component/product dependency model and normalized SQL analysis.
  • Existing sourcing, greedy recovery and constrained optimization with independent feasibility checks.
  • Capacity, material balance, budget, assembly and deadline constraints.
  • A public decision lab with scenario presets, network exploration, stress experiments and exports.

Recorded evaluation

24 synthetic scenarios produced 72 independently verified policy plans. The default example uses 20 fictional suppliers, eight components, three SKUs and 30 orders.

Project scope

All business records and comparisons are synthetic. The browser runs the included fixture; the extensible Python planner and API run separately.
